name: After Work
source:
You have just been hired as a marketing photographer for SPARK: the leading force in designing and manufacturing professional-quality cameras. Your team is full of young, attractive professionals all working towards one goal: to create a campaign that highlights the faces behind the company. 

Though your contract only lasts 6 months, you plan to make the most of it: both in and out of the office! While on the clock, collaborate with your team on the campaign and get to know them in a casual workplace setting. After work, form deep, meaningful connections with the coworker of your choosing and watch a romance bloom.

[From [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/2575810/After_Work/]Steam[/url]]
translation:
你刚刚受聘于SPARK，担任营销摄影师。这家公司是专业级相机设计与制造领域的佼佼者。你的团队里满是年轻迷人的专业人士，大家都在为同一个目标努力：策划一场宣传活动，让人们看见公司背后的那些面孔。

虽然合同只有六个月，你却打算好好利用这段时光，办公室内外都不例外！上班时，和团队一起筹备活动，在轻松的工作环境中慢慢了解大家。下班后，你可以选择一位同事，与对方建立深厚而真挚的联系，看着爱情悄然萌芽。

［摘自[url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/2575810/After_Work/]Steam[/url]］
